displayName: White Clover — Ladino (perennial cover / living mulch)
harvestIndicators: Kill by thoroughly uprooting and incorporating it (plow, field cultivate, undercut or rotary till)
Close mowing, or partial tillage that leaves roots undisturbed, only suppresses it
notes: Low-growing perennial — works as a living mulch in orchard alleyways or vegetable interplant. N-fixer + pollinator-friendly.
